title: Self-Learning AI Agent
problem: Most student "AI agents" never actually learn. This one improves from reward, and the improvement is measured.
summary: Tabular Q-learning on FrozenLake and a from-scratch Deep Q-Network on CartPole, with held-out evaluation, statistical tests, an ablation study and a Streamlit dashboard.

title: QuickBite: Food-Delivery Analytics Platform
problem: Turn raw order events into trustworthy KPIs, predict cancellations, and let non-technical users ask questions in plain English.
summary: Synthetic data generator, raw → staging → mart DuckDB pipeline with tests and bad-row quarantine, Streamlit KPI dashboard, cancellation model and a read-only Gemini text-to-SQL assistant. Dockerised.

title: System Capacity & Care Load Analytics
problem: Give administrators an early warning when the care system is close to capacity.
summary: Cleans and validates public HHS daily data (2023–2025), engineers 15+ load and pressure KPIs, and backtests Linear Regression, Holt and ARIMA forecasts for 30 / 60 / 90 days.

title: TeleConnect: Customer Churn Analysis
problem: Which customers leave, what they have in common, and where the retention budget should go.
summary: Statistical analysis of ~7,000 telecom customers, delivered as a one-page brief for the VP of Customer. Month-to-month contracts churn at 35.7% compared with 3.9% for two-year contracts.

title: EduPro Learner Analytics
problem: Show who EduPro's learners are, using only the data that was actually supplied.
summary: Interactive dashboard over the EduPro users roster: age bands, gender composition, filters, free-text search and CSV export. It states its data-coverage limits instead of inventing course metrics.
